ebm-soru-kutuphane.soru: What is the İnebey Madrasa used as today?
ipuclari: Remember the story's last sentence: what moved here from Orhan Mosque in 1969?
It has to do with books.
ebm-soru-kutuphane.dogru_metin: In 1969 the manuscripts and printed works of the library in Orhan Mosque moved to the madrasa; the building is now the Bursa İnebey Manuscript Library. The canning factory was its use until 1962.

ebm-hikaye.metin: You listened to or read the story of the İnebey Madrasa to the end.
